settings.editor: For over 20 years, we've been crafting custom homes and outdoor spaces that exceed expectations. From concept to completion, we build your vision with uncompromising quality.

Grander Construction has spent over two decades perfecting the art of custom home building in Middle Tennessee. We believe that building a home should be an exciting journey, not a stressful ordeal.

Our approach combines old-world craftsmanship with modern building science, ensuring every home we build is not just beautiful, but built to last for generations.
From modern farmhouses to traditional estates, we bring your vision to life with meticulous attention to detail.
Extend your living space outdoors with custom pavilions, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, and more.
Add versatile living spaces with custom pool houses, detached garages, guest houses, and accessory dwelling units.
Expand your home seamlessly with sunrooms, room additions, kitchen expansions, and primary suite additions.
Let's discuss your vision and create something extraordinary together. Our team is ready to guide you through every step of the building process.
